note_tweet.text:
TrueFoundry now integrates with @straikerai .

Teams routing LLM and agent traffic through the TrueFoundry AI Gateway can now add Straiker as a guardrail that checks every prompt on the way in and every model response on the way out: prompt injection, manipulated agents, risky tool calls, and multi-step attacks that don’t fit inside a single request, all enforced at the gateway, with no adapter to build and no changes to application code.

Security teams set the controls per agent in the Straiker console. Straiker returns an allow-or-block verdict in under 300 ms, and the gateway enforces it. Start in Audit mode to see what gets flagged, flip to Enforce when it looks right, and every check shows up in TrueFoundry’s request traces. Combined with TrueFoundry’s unified access to 2,500+ LLMs, rate limiting, cost tracking, and governance, platform teams keep one governed gateway and application teams ship agents without rebuilding security in each one.

One gateway. Every request, protected.

Thanks to the @straikerai  team for the collaboration!

note_tweet.text:
TrueFoundry now integrates with @confident_ai.

Teams routing LLM traffic through the TrueFoundry AI Gateway can now send every request to Confident AI as an OpenTelemetry trace and score it with online evaluations: answer relevancy, faithfulness, toxicity, and PII leakage, all running on live production traffic, with zero tracing code in your applications.

Evaluation runs asynchronously, off the request path, so it adds no latency to user-facing calls. Combined with TrueFoundry’s unified access to 1,000+ LLMs, rate limiting, cost tracking, and governance, teams get one place to route every model call and see how good each answer actually was, with quality scores sitting right next to latency and cost.

One gateway. Every request, evaluated.

Thanks to the @confident_ai  for the collaboration!
